035/**
036 * A var resolver session that combines a {@link VarResolver} with one or more session objects.
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * Instances of this class are considered light-weight and fast to construct, use, and discard.
040 *
041 * <p>
042 * This class contains the workhorse code for var resolution.
043 *
044 * <p>
045 * Instances of this class are created through the {@link VarResolver#createSession()} and
046 * {@link VarResolver#createSession(WritableBeanStore)} methods.
047 *
048 * <h2 class='section'>Notes:</h2><ul>
049 *    <li class='warn'>This class is not guaranteed to be thread safe.
050 * </ul>
051 *
052 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
053 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/MarshallSimpleVariableLanguage">Marshall Simple Variable Language</a>
054 * </ul>
055 */
056@SuppressWarnings({
057   "java:S1192", // Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants
058   "resource" // VarResolver resources managed by calling code
059})
060public class VarResolverSession {
061
062   private static boolean containsVars(Collection<?> c) {
063      var f = Flag.create();
064      c.forEach(x -> {
065         if (x instanceof CharSequence && x.toString().contains("$"))
066            f.set();
067      });
068      return f.isSet();
069   }
070
071   private static boolean containsVars(Map<?,?> m) {
072      var f = Flag.create();
073      m.forEach((k, v) -> {
074         if (v instanceof CharSequence && v.toString().contains("$"))
075            f.set();
076      });
077      return f.isSet();
078   }
079
080   private static boolean containsVars(Object array) {
081      for (var i = 0; i < Array.getLength(array); i++) {
082         var o = Array.get(array, i);
083         if (o instanceof CharSequence && o.toString().contains("$"))
084            return true;
085      }
086      return false;
087   }
088
089   private static final Set<String> HTML_DOC_PASSTHROUGH_VARS = Set.of("W", "C", "RS");
090
091   private static final Set<String> SCRIPT_STYLE_REFUSED_VARS = Set.of("RQ", "RH", "RF", "RP", "RA", "SA", "R");
092
093   private final VarResolver context;
094
095   private final WritableBeanStore beanStore;
096
097   private int recursionDepth;
098
099   /** Number of {@code ${...}} references inside {@code #{...}} currently being resolved on this session. */
100   private int exprVarDepth;
101
102   private boolean htmlDocEncode;
103
104   private boolean scriptStyleRefuse;
105
106   private Function<Object,String> valueFormatter;
107
108   /**
109    * Constructor.
110    *
111    * @param context
112    *    The {@link VarResolver} context object that contains the {@link Var Vars} and context objects associated with
113    *    that resolver.
114    * @param beanStore The bean store to use for resolving beans needed by vars.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (this session will then have no parent bean store, and only beans explicitly added via {@link #bean(Class, Object)} will be resolvable).
115    *
116    */
117   public VarResolverSession(VarResolver context, WritableBeanStore beanStore) {
118      this.context = context;
119      this.beanStore = new BasicBeanStore(beanStore);
120   }
121
122   /**
123    * Looks up a registered function by exact name.
124    *
125    * <p>
126    * Functions excluded by {@link VarResolver.Builder#allowFunctions(String...)} are not returned, so a
127    * <jk>null</jk> result means absent <i>or denied</i>; use {@link #isFunctionDenied(String)} to tell them apart.
128    *
129    * @param name The function name.
130    * @return The function, or <jk>null</jk> if none is registered under that name (or it is not allowed).
131    */
132   public VarFunction findFunction(String name) { return context.findFunction(name); }
133
134   /**
135    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if the named function (or operator) is excluded by the resolver's allowlist.
136    *
137    * @param name The function name (e.g. <js>"upper"</js> or <js>"$op.add"</js>).
138    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the name was registered and filtered out by the allowlist, or is an <c>$op.*</c> name the allowlist does not permit.
139    */
140   public boolean isFunctionDenied(String name) { return context.isDenied(name) || (name.startsWith("$op.") && ! context.isAllowed(name)); }
141
142   /**
143    * Resolves a <c>${Type:body}</c> reference to a typed value for the expression evaluator.
144    *
145    * <p>
146    * Finds the var by prefix and returns <c>var.doResolveValue(session, body)</c>, so defaults ({@link DefaultingVar})
147    * and multipart keys are honoured.  The body is resolved with the existing nested-marker machinery first when the
148    * var allows nesting and the body contains a <c>$</c>.  The {@link #resolveScriptStyle(String)} refusal and the
149    * {@link #resolveHtmlDoc(String)} encoding apply exactly as they do to template <c>${...}</c> references: under
150    * HTML-doc encoding a value from a non-passthrough var is escaped, and a non-<c>String</c> value other than a
151    * <c>Number</c> or <c>Boolean</c> is first converted with <c>String.valueOf</c> (as the template path does), so
152    * markup inside a collection or bean cannot bypass the escaping.
153    *
154    * @param prefix The var name (e.g. <js>"S"</js>).
155    * @param body The var body (already in the var's own syntax, e.g. <js>"key,default"</js>).
156    * @return The value, or <jk>null</jk> if absent or (lenient mode) the var is unknown.
157    * @throws VarResolverException If the var is unknown and the resolver is strict, or the var fails.
158    */
159   Object resolveValue(String prefix, String body) {
160      var v = isScriptStyleRefused(prefix) ? null : getVar(prefix);
161      if (v == null) {
162         if (context.strict)
163            throw new VarResolverException("Unknown or unavailable variable '%s'", prefix);
164         return null;
165      }
166      try {
167         var b = (v.allowNested() && body.indexOf('$') != -1) ? resolve(body) : body;
168         var r = v.doResolveValue(this, b);
169         // HTML-doc chrome: values are escaped unless the var is an HTML passthrough, as in templates.
170         if (! htmlDocEncode || r == null || r instanceof Number || r instanceof Boolean)
171            return r;
172         return applyHtmlDocChromeEncoding(prefix, r instanceof String s2 ? s2 : String.valueOf(r));
173      } catch (VarResolverException e) {
174         throw e;
175      } catch (Exception e) {
176         throw new VarResolverException(e, "Problem occurred resolving variable '%s': %s", prefix, e.getMessage());
177      }
178   }
179
180   /**
181    * Overrides the value formatter for this session.
182    *
183    * <p>
184    * The override <em>replaces</em> the resolver's formatter and also formats {@link Structure} values.
185    *
186    * @param value The formatter.  <jk>null</jk> reverts to the resolver's formatter.
187    * @return This object.
188    */
189   public VarResolverSession valueFormatter(Function<Object,String> value) {
190      this.valueFormatter = value;
191      return this;
192   }
193
194   /**
195    * Formats the typed result of an expression as text.
196    *
197    * @param value The value.  May be <jk>null</jk>.
198    * @return The text; never <jk>null</jk>.
199    */
200   public String formatValue(Object value) {
201      String r;
202      if (valueFormatter != null)
203         r = valueFormatter.apply(value);
204      else if (value instanceof Structure)
205         r = value.toString();
206      else
207         r = context.valueFormatter.apply(value);
208      return r == null ? "" : r;
209   }
210
211   /** @return The maximum collection size for expressions. */
212   int maxCollectionSize() { return context.maxCollectionSize; }
213
214   /** @return The maximum expression nesting depth. */
215   int maxExprDepth() { return context.maxExprDepth; }
216
217   /**
218    * Enters a {@code ${...}} reference inside {@code #{...}}.
219    *
220    * <p>
221    * Such references compile their body lazily, so a deep {@code #{${...#{${...}}...}}} chain would recurse at
222    * evaluation time.  The chain is capped at {@code maxExprDepth}; every successful call must be paired with
223    * {@link #exitExprVar()}.
224    *
225    * @return <jk>false</jk> (and no depth change) if the cap is reached.
226    */
227   boolean enterExprVar() {
228      if (exprVarDepth >= context.maxExprDepth)
229         return false;
230      exprVarDepth++;
231      return true;
232   }
233
234   /** Leaves a reference entered with {@link #enterExprVar()}. */
235   void exitExprVar() {
236      exprVarDepth--;
237   }
238
239   /**
240    * Returns whether the owning resolver is in strict mode.
241    *
242    * @return <jk>true</jk> if strict.
243    */
244   public boolean isStrict() { return context.strict; }
245
246   /**
247    * Adds a bean to this session.
248    *
249    * @param <T> The bean type.
250    * @param c The bean type.
251    * @param value The bean.
252    * @return This object.
253    */
254   public <T> VarResolverSession bean(Class<T> c, T value) {
255      beanStore.addBean(c, value);
256      return this;
257   }
258
259   /**
260    * Returns the bean from the registered bean store.
261    *
262    * @param <T> The value type.
263    * @param c The bean type.
264    * @return
265    *    The bean.
266    *    <br>Never <jk>null</jk>.
267    */
268   public <T> Optional<T> getBean(Class<T> c) {
269      Optional<T> t = beanStore.getBean(c);
270      if (! t.isPresent())
271         t = context.beanStore.getBean(c);
272      return t;
273   }

275   /**
276    * Resolve all variables in the specified string.
277    *
278    * @param s
279    *    The string to resolve variables in.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <jk>null</jk>).
280    * @return
281    *    The new string with all variables resolved, or the same string if no variables were found.
282    *    <br>Returns <jk>null</jk> if the input was <jk>null</jk>.
283    */
284   public String resolve(String s) {
285      if (s == null)
286         return null;
287      if (s.isEmpty())
288         return s;
289      return context.compile(s).resolve(this);
290   }
291
292   /**
293    * Re-resolves a var's output, enforcing the resolver's maximum recursion depth.
294    *
295    * @param s The string to resolve.
296    * @return The resolved string.
297    * @throws VarResolverException If the maximum recursion depth is exceeded.
298    */
299   String resolveRecursive(String s) {
300      if (++recursionDepth > context.maxRecursionDepth) {
301         recursionDepth--;
302         throw new VarResolverException("Maximum variable recursion depth (%s) exceeded while resolving '%s'", context.maxRecursionDepth, s.length() > 80 ? s.substring(0, 80) + "..." : s);
303      }
304      try {
305         return resolve(s);
306      } finally {
307         recursionDepth--;
308      }
309   }
310
311   /**
312    * Resolves SVL variables for HTML-doc chrome fields that write raw HTML.
313    *
314    * <p>
315    * Literal characters from the template (including tags) pass through unchanged. Each SVL
316    * substitution is XML-escaped via {@link StringUtils#escapeXml(String)} before insert, except
317    * the HTML-passthrough vars {@code $W}, {@code $C}, and {@code $RS}.
318    *
319    * <p>
320    * Plain {@link #resolve(String)} is unchanged. Use this only for HTML-doc chrome (aside, header,
321    * footer, nav HTML fragments, head, no-results).
322    *
323    * @param s The chrome template. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
324    * @return The resolved chrome string, or <jk>null</jk> if the input was <jk>null</jk>.
325    */
326   public String resolveHtmlDoc(String s) {
327      htmlDocEncode = true;
328      try {
329         return resolve(s);
330      } finally {
331         htmlDocEncode = false;
332      }
333   }
334
335   /**
336    * Resolves SVL variables for {@code <script>} and {@code <style>} chrome.
337    *
338    * <p>
339    * Request-derived vars ({@code $RQ}, {@code $RH}, {@code $RF}, {@code $RP}, {@code $RA},
340    * {@code $SA}, {@code $R}) are left unresolved (same as an unknown var). Other vars including
341    * {@code $W}, {@code $C}, and {@code $RS} still resolve.
342    *
343    * @param s The script or style template. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
344    * @return The resolved string, or <jk>null</jk> if the input was <jk>null</jk>.
345    */
346   public String resolveScriptStyle(String s) {
347      scriptStyleRefuse = true;
348      try {
349         return resolve(s);
350      } finally {
351         scriptStyleRefuse = false;
352      }
353   }
354
355   /**
356    * Compiles the given template string into a reusable {@link VarTemplate}.
357    *
358    * <p>
359    * Equivalent to {@link VarResolver#compile(String) this.context.compile(input)}; provided on
360    * the session for symmetry with {@link #resolve(String)}. The returned template is bound to
361    * the underlying {@link VarResolver}, not to this session — see the {@link VarTemplate}
362    * class javadoc for the compile-binding contract.
363    *
364    * @param input The template string. May be {@code null}.
365    * @return A new {@link VarTemplate} bound to the underlying resolver.
366    */
367   public VarTemplate compile(String input) {
368      return context.compile(input);
369   }
370
371   /**
372    * Returns a session-bound {@link Supplier} that re-resolves the given template against
373    * <i>this</i> session each time {@link Supplier#get()} is called.
374    *
375    * <p>
376    * Unlike {@link VarResolver#resolveSupplier(String)} — which opens a fresh session per
377    * {@code .get()} and is threadsafe to share — this Supplier captures the existing session
378    * and reuses it. <b>It is therefore not threadsafe</b>; it inherits the standard
379    * "{@link VarResolverSession} is not guaranteed to be thread safe" contract.
380    *
381    * <p>
382    * Use this variant only when the caller owns the session lifecycle and the perf saving of
383    * skipping per-call session construction matters. For shared / cross-thread use cases,
384    * prefer {@link VarResolver#resolveSupplier(String)}.
385    *
386    * @param input The template string. May be {@code null}.
387    * @return A {@code Supplier<String>} bound to this session.
388    */
389   public Supplier<String> resolveSupplier(String input) {
390      return compile(input).asSupplier(this);
391   }
392
393   /**
394    * Resolves the specified strings in the string array.
395    *
396    * @param in The string array containing variables to resolve.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or a {@link NullPointerException} is thrown, though individual elements can be <jk>null</jk>.
397    * @return An array with resolved strings.  Elements are <jk>null</jk> where the corresponding input element was <jk>null</jk>.
398    */
399   public String[] resolve(String[] in) {
400      var out = new String[in.length];
401      for (var i = 0; i < in.length; i++)
402         out[i] = resolve(in[i]);
403      return out;
404   }
405
406   /**
407    * Convenience method for resolving variables in arbitrary objects.
408    *
409    * <p>
410    * Supports resolving variables in the following object types:
411    * <ul>
412    *    <li>{@link CharSequence}
413    *    <li>Arrays containing values of type {@link CharSequence}.
414    *    <li>Collections containing values of type {@link CharSequence}.
415    *       <br>Collection class must have a no-arg constructor.
416    *    <li>Maps containing values of type {@link CharSequence}.
417    *       <br>Map class must have a no-arg constructor.
418    * </ul>
419    *
420    * @param <T> The value type.
421    * @param o The object.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <jk>null</jk>).
422    * @return The same object if no resolution was needed, otherwise a new object or data structure if resolution was
423    * needed.  Returns <jk>null</jk> if the input was <jk>null</jk>.
424    */
425   @SuppressWarnings({
426      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for recursive resolution logic
427      "rawtypes", // Raw types necessary for generic resolution
428      "unchecked" // Type erasure requires unchecked operations
429   })
430   public <T> T resolve(T o) {
431      if (o == null)
432         return null;
433      if (o instanceof CharSequence o2)
434         return (T)resolve(o2.toString());
435      if (isArray(o)) {
436         if (! containsVars(o))
437            return o;
438         var o2 = Array.newInstance(o.getClass().getComponentType(), Array.getLength(o));
439         for (var i = 0; i < Array.getLength(o); i++)
440            Array.set(o2, i, resolve(Array.get(o, i)));
441         return (T)o2;
442      }
443      if (o instanceof Set o2) {
444         try {
445            if (! containsVars(o2))
446               return o;
447            Set o3 = info(o).getDeclaredConstructor(x -> x.isPublic() && x.getParameterCount() == 0).map(ci -> safe(() -> (Set)ci.inner().newInstance())).orElseGet(LinkedHashSet::new);
448            Set o4 = o3;
449            o2.forEach(x -> o4.add(resolve(x)));
450            return (T)o3;
451         } catch (VarResolverException e) {
452            throw e;
453         } catch (Exception e) {
454            throw new VarResolverException(e, "Problem occurred resolving set.");
455         }
456      }
457      if (o instanceof List o2) {
458         try {
459            if (! containsVars(o2))
460               return o;
461            List o3 = info(o).getDeclaredConstructor(x -> x.isPublic() && x.getParameterCount() == 0).map(ci -> safe(() -> (List)ci.inner().newInstance())).orElseGet(() -> list());
462            List o4 = o3;
463            o2.forEach(x -> o4.add(resolve(x)));
464            return (T)o3;
465         } catch (VarResolverException e) {
466            throw e;
467         } catch (Exception e) {
468            throw new VarResolverException(e, "Problem occurred resolving collection.");
469         }
470      }
471      if (o instanceof Map o2) {
472         try {
473            if (! containsVars(o2))
474               return o;
475            Map o3 = info(o).getDeclaredConstructor(x -> x.isPublic() && x.getParameterCount() == 0).map(ci -> safe(() -> (Map)ci.inner().newInstance())).orElseGet(LinkedHashMap::new);
476            Map o4 = o3;
477            o2.forEach((k, v) -> o4.put(k, resolve(v)));
478            return (T)o3;
479         } catch (VarResolverException e) {
480            throw e;
481         } catch (Exception e) {
482            throw new VarResolverException(e, "Problem occurred resolving map.");
483         }
484      }
485      return o;
486   }
487
488   /**
489    * Resolves variables in the specified string and sends the output to the specified writer.
490    *
491    * <p>
492    * More efficient than first parsing to a string and then serializing to the writer since this method doesn't need
493    * to construct a large string.
494    *
495    * @param s The string to resolve variables in.  Can be <jk>null</jk>, in which case the writer is left unchanged.
496    * @param out The writer to write to.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
497    * @return The same writer.
498    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
499    */
500   public Writer resolveTo(String s, Writer out) throws IOException {
501      if (s == null)
502         return out;
503      if (s.isEmpty()) {
504         return out;
505      }
506      return context.compile(s).resolveTo(this, out);
507   }

509   protected FluentMap<String,Object> properties() {
510      // @formatter:off
511      return filteredBeanPropertyMap()
512         .a("context.beanStore", this.context.beanStore)
513         .a("var", this.context.getVarMap().keySet())
514         .a("session.beanStore", beanStore);
515      // @formatter:on
516   }
517
518   @Override /* Overridden from Object */
519   public String toString() {
520      return r(properties());
521   }

523   /**
524    * Returns the {@link Var} with the specified name.
525    *
526    * @param name The var name (e.g. <js>"S"</js>).  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
527    * @return The {@link Var} instance, or <jk>null</jk> if no <c>Var</c> is associated with the specified name.
528    */
529   protected Var getVar(String name) {
530      Var v = this.context.getVarMap().get(name);
531      return nn(v) && v.canResolve(this) ? v : null;
532   }
533
534   /**
535    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if this session is resolving HTML-doc chrome and substitutions should be XML-escaped.
536    *
537    * @return <jk>true</jk> if HTML-doc chrome encoding is enabled.
538    */
539   boolean isHtmlDocEncode() {
540      return htmlDocEncode;
541   }
542
543   /**
544    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if {@code varName} must be left unresolved in script/style chrome.
545    *
546    * @param varName The SVL var prefix (e.g. <js>"RQ"</js>).
547    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the var should fall through like an unknown var.
548    */
549   boolean isScriptStyleRefused(String varName) {
550      return scriptStyleRefuse && SCRIPT_STYLE_REFUSED_VARS.contains(varName);
551   }
552
553   /**
554    * XML-escapes an SVL substitution when HTML-doc chrome encoding is enabled and the var is not passthrough.
555    *
556    * @param varName The SVL var prefix.
557    * @param replacement The resolved substitution text.
558    * @return The possibly escaped replacement.
559    */
560   String applyHtmlDocChromeEncoding(String varName, String replacement) {
561      if (! htmlDocEncode || replacement == null || HTML_DOC_PASSTHROUGH_VARS.contains(varName))
562         return replacement;
563      return StringUtils.escapeXml(replacement);
564   }
565}
